#!/usr/bin/env python3
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Mesh
import MeshPart

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Unnamed")

# Create a cube with 20mm side length
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Cube")
box.Length = 20
box.Width = 20
box.Height = 20

# Recompute to ensure the box is created
doc.recompute()

print("Box created successfully")
print(f"Box Length: {box.Length}")
print(f"Box Width: {box.Width}")
print(f"Box Height: {box.Height}")

shape = box.Shape

# Create mesh from shape using MeshPart.meshFromShape
# The function signature is meshFromShape(shape, linearDeflection, angularDeflection, relative)
# For max distance 0.2, we use linearDeflection = 0.2
mesh = MeshPart.meshFromShape(shape, linearDeflection=0.2, angularDeflection=0.5, relative=False)
print(f"Mesh created with {len(mesh.Points)} points")

# Create point cloud from the mesh
point_cloud = doc.addObject("Mesh::Feature", "PointCloud")
point_cloud.Mesh = mesh

print("Point cloud created successfully")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Document saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

# Verify the document
print("\nVerifying document contents:")
print(f"Number of objects: {len(doc.Objects)}")
for obj in doc.Objects:
    print(f"  - {obj.Name}: {obj.TypeId}")
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Mesh
import MeshPart

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Unnamed")

# Create a cube with 20mm side length
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Cube")
box.Length = 20
box.Width = 20
box.Height = 20

# Recompute to ensure the box is created
doc.recompute()

print("=== Cube Properties ===")
print(f"Length: {box.Length}")
print(f"Width: {box.Width}")
print(f"Height: {box.Height}")

shape = box.Shape

# Create mesh from shape with linearDeflection=0.2 (maximum distance)
# This ensures no point on the mesh is more than 0.2mm from the original shape

print("\n=== Mesh Properties ===")
print(f"Number of points: {len(mesh.Points)}")
print(f"Number of facets: {len(mesh.Facets)}")
